Wood documentation

Tools with a clear purpose.

Wood brings native mod management and time controls to TUNG.

What Wood is

Wood is an independent TUNG modding toolkit. Its first included mod, Time Warp, controls Unreal’s global world time dilation with presets, hotkeys, and persistent settings.

How it works

A pinned UE4SS loader starts WoodRuntime inside the game. Wood creates Unreal UMG widgets for its menu and settings. The desktop launcher reads manifests and communicates with the runtime through a local command queue. Runtime acknowledgements distinguish requested settings from engine-confirmed values.

What is included

  • A standalone launcher and searchable mod library.
  • Native menus and settings accessible with F10.
  • Wood Utilities: auto-speedrunner mode, application volume, and mouse controls.
  • Time Warp world-speed controls from 0.05× to 4×.
  • A single-file setup executable and installed uninstaller.
  • An example Lua extension and documented settings API.

Release status

Version 2.2.2 adds Wood Utilities to the standalone distribution. Installation and restoration are covered by regression tests. Time dilation and native widget controls were verified in the installed game during development. Compatibility with future TUNG releases is not guaranteed.

The executables are currently unsigned. This release has no automatic updater, mod marketplace, input recording, or replay system.

Open development

Wood’s own source is prepared as a local Git repository with an MIT license, build instructions, and GitHub Actions release workflow. Public GitHub publication is pending. The UE4SS runtime retains its own upstream license.
